# Money Manager Repository Instructions

At the start of every new repository chat or session, the first action before
answering a project task, suggesting changes, or implementing changes is to
read and follow `docs/AI_WORKFLOW.md`. It defines the mandatory startup process,
document precedence, feature-ID requirement, scope controls, quality gates, and
approval rules.

Do not implement uncataloged scope. Do not commit, push, create or modify pull
requests, or merge without explicit user approval.
